Sam (fin): Morning — alert shows ~9.3k untagged GPU-hours in apac-south-2 overnight (~$17.5k). Anyone own this?
InfraBot: ALERT: untagged_gpu_hours=9300 region=apac-south-2 window=2026-03-25T23:00Z-2026-03-26T07:00Z export=s3://billing/exports/2026-03-26/apac-s2-untagged-9300.csv
Eli (ml): That's likely our elastic grid for text2vec-runs. We launched a distributed sweep and forgot to include `cost_center` in the job template. Sorry — posting mapping now.
Eli (ml): Upload: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-25/text2vec-backfill.csv (run_id,user,email,gpu_hours).
Nora (platform): Platform can cover up to $9k from reserve this month. We can also retro-tag the export if you provide run_id -> owner. Ops prefers that for correct team quotas.
Sam (fin): OK two options: 1) backfill tags (preferred) and charge ML R&D for $17.5k, 2) Platform covers $9k, finance covers remaining ~$8.5k as internal transfer and we reconcile next invoice. Need explicit approvers and the backfill artifact.
Eli (ml): We'll do the backfill immediately and attach logs. Prefer option 1 for bookkeeping accuracy, but option 2 helps avoid team budget alerts.
Nora (platform): I'll approve $9k if finance signs off on the remaining transfer. Nora (platform) :white_check_mark:.
Sam (fin): I approve covering the $8.5k residual as internal credit to ML R&D contingent on: (a) backfill file in S3, (b) run-owner mapping, (c) audit comment in ledger: "retrospective tagging for apac-south-2 elastic sweep; platform covered $9k; finance credited $8.5k to ML R&D."
Eli (ml): Backfill complete. Log: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-25/text2vec-backfill-complete.log. All runs now have cost_center=ml-rd.
InfraBot: NOTE: internal-transfer pending INT-2026-03422 (platform_cover=9000, finance_credit=8500).
Sam (fin): Creating internal invoice INT-2026-03422 and attaching backfill artifacts. Will close when accounting confirms. Please add a follow-up ticket to require `cost_center` on job submit templates.
Nora (platform): Opening infra ticket TICKET-PLAT-789 to enforce submit-time validation and add a pre-submit hook in training repos.
Eli (ml): Adding a git pre-submit hook in repo and will add documentation to onboarding checklist.
Sam (fin): Thanks — marking resolved once accounting confirms posting.
